properties.Key Activities proposed for Soil and Wat:
1. Soil conservation practices - Slopy area near the Velgolla canal (35°-50°)
2. Soil conservation practices - Slopy area near the Medawela canal (35°-50°)
properties.Proposed measure/s:
1. SALT- 1000 m
2. Lock and spills - 500 m
3. Stone terracing - 500 m
4. Agronomic practices should be adapted at optimum level (conservation tillage, crop rotation and diversification, cover crops, mulching, contour farming, windbreaks and shelterbelts, water management techniques, and nutrient management etc., as applied). Slope of the platform of terrace farming should be maintained towards the inside. Also, the walls of the terraces should not be scrapped away during land preparation. A ridge/embarkment should be maintained at the free end of the tarrance (opposite to tarrace wall). Weedicide application to terrace wall is not recommended. Additionally, planing Vetiver like grasses is encourgaed in steep slopes.
